#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    double min_diff = 1e15;
    long long best_a = 0, best_b = 0;

    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        long long a = (x * b) / y;
        auto check = [&](long long a_candidate) {
            double diff = fabs(x * b - a_candidate * y) / (double)(y * b);
            if (diff < min_diff) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_a = a_candidate;
                best_b = b;
            }
        };

        if (a > 0 && (x * b - (a - 1) * y) == 0) {
            cout << a - 1 << "/" << b;
            return 0;
        }
        if ((x * b - a * y) == 0) {
            cout << a << "/" << b;
            return 0;
        }
        if ((x * b - (a + 1) * y) == 0) {
            cout << a + 1 << "/" << b;
            return 0;
        }

        check(a - 1);
        check(a);
        check(a + 1);
    }
    cout << best_a << "/" << best_b << endl;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
